title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（渡邊伸行研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Watanabe Nobuyuki)
teachers:
WATANABE Nobuyuki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: The aim of the Design Project III is to be able to plan and develop products and systems that can be used safely and comfortably, and are enjoyable, and to be able to propose services that consider the psychological function of humans. The fundamental policy is to address one's own research theme by utilizing the knowledge on psychological function, and techniques of scientific measurement and evaluation.
advice:
Lectures, practice exercises, and experiments are conducted when needed. Meetings are conveniently held and students report their own studies and engage in discussion. At the end of the former semester, a debriefing session of the department is held and all students must give an oral presentation on the progress of their own studies. At the end of the latter semester, the same debriefing session is held and all students must give an oral presentation on the consequences of their own studies.
Students must participate in the meeting held every week, and perform their studies while engaging in the task for their research interests. Students need to not only do their own studies, but also have interest in and discuss the studies conducted by others.
The research interests in our laboratory are human communication ( especially nonverbal behavior and its cognition), man-machine communication (human interface), creation and evaluation of regional culture contents that promote communication in different regions, and their peripheral domain. It is preferred that students choose their research theme based on their daily lives. To realize this, students need to make a habit of observing the events or products around their daily lives carefully and think about them.

activityGoals.body: Ability to discuss various problems around us from a psychological point of view.
Ability to choose a research method on the research theme, and conduct experimental design.
Ability to conduct the experiment, and obtain the data to fulfill the purpose.
Ability to interpret the obtained data objectively and write a thesis.
Ability to notice your role in seminar activities, and cooperate with other class members.
Ability to create an action agenda for your future career.

lessons.content:
Meetings are held one or two times per week.
Activities for the meeting are as follows:
-Announcement of graduate study topics.
-Discussion on research ethics and creating
  documents for ethical review.
-Report on the progress of each study.
-Discussion on each study.
-Discussion on each study individually.
-Rehearsal of oral presentation.
-Recreation, etc.

The research interests in our laboratory are human communication ( especially nonverbal behavior and its cognition), man-machine communication (human interface), creation and evaluation of regional culture contents that promote communication in different regions, and their peripheral domain.
